blocks.text: A change set previews proposed stack changes without executing them.
Before authorizing execution, review additions, modifications, removals and replacement indicators. A preview does not guarantee execution success.
For a new stack, create a CREATE change set from the supplied template, wait for completion, inspect it, then execute the approved set to provision resources.

steps.title: Compare the evidence, not the label

blocks.text: For the supplied new-stack template, wait for CREATE change-set completion and compare its additions with the approved scope. An extra unapproved addition is a discrepancy, not permission to proceed. Keep the requested scope, preview and later execution outcome separate; a matching preview can still be followed by failed execution.
A preview is not execution evidence, and approval is not a guarantee of execution success.

steps.title: Judge the evidence
steps.lede: Read the supplied case and choose the interpretation supported by its evidence.

public.prompt:
Read this update preview:
```text
OrdersHost: AWS::EC2::Instance
Action: Modify
Replacement: True
Preview creation: CREATE_COMPLETE
Approval: replacement is unintended
```
Which judgement follows?

options.text: Withhold execution authorization: the EC2 modification indicates replacement.
Authorize it because Modify rules out replacement.
Authorize it because preview success guarantees execution success.

o1.message: Review the action and replacement indicator against approved scope before execution.

o2.message: A modification can carry a replacement indicator; this excerpt explicitly does.

o3.message: A preview is not execution and does not guarantee execution success.

correct.message: Correct. A change set previews proposed stack resource changes without executing them. Review additions, modifications, removals and replacement indicators before authorizing execution; a preview does not guarantee that execution will succeed.

incorrect.message: Compare the supplied evidence with the required criterion. A change set previews proposed stack resource changes without executing them. Review additions, modifications, removals and replacement indicators before authorizing execution; a preview does not guarantee that execution will succeed.

hints: Separate the configuration or approval from the recorded outcome.
Check every named criterion, not only a successful status or familiar label.

steps.title: Review CloudFormation change sets
steps.lede: Read the supplied excerpts in this step and decide which satisfy the stated requirements and which are defective or unsafe.

public.prompt: Read each CloudFormation review record. Decide whether it meets the supplied approval: CREATE provisions only one sandbox EC2 instance after inspection and approval; unintended update replacement is not authorized. Distinguish preview from execution.

items.text: CREATE set orders-create: CREATE_COMPLETE; inspected: OrdersHost Add AWS::EC2::Instance, one instance only; scope approved; execute orders-create after approval: complete, one sandbox EC2 instance provisioned. Separate update: OrdersHost Modify, Replacement=True; replacement unintended; execution withheld. Preview success was not treated as an execution guarantee.

CREATE set orders-create: CREATE_COMPLETE; inspected: OrdersHost Add AWS::EC2::Instance; execution not requested. Review conclusion: preview alone provisioned one instance and guarantees successful execution. Update: Modify, Replacement=True; unintended replacement withheld.

CREATE set orders-create inspected and approved for one EC2 instance, then executed successfully. Separate update: OrdersHost Modify AWS::EC2::Instance, Replacement=True; approval excludes replacement; authorized anyway because Action=Modify.

i1.message: Inspection and scope approval precede execution of the specific set; the update replacement is withheld.

i2.message: A change set preview does not execute or provision resources and cannot guarantee execution success.

i3.message: The replacement indicator must be reviewed even for Modify; unintended replacement is not authorized.

correct.message: Correct. A change set previews proposed stack resource changes without executing them. Review additions, modifications, removals and replacement indicators before authorizing execution; a preview does not guarantee that execution will succeed.

Review additions, modifications, removals and replacement indicators before authorizing execution; a preview does not guarantee that execution will succeed.
